caption:
Lulu works all day and does CrossFit every evening. Everything feels tight, and he wonders if a massage can sort it all out.

Remedial massage can help muscles feel easier and support recovery, but it works alongside training load and rehab rather than replacing them.

Hybi's tips: tell your therapist what you've been training, keep it lighter right before a big comp, and book deeper work on rest days. The next day, keep moving gently.

A sudden sharp pain during a lift, tingling, or pain that isn't easing after two weeks is worth an assessment first. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🏋️

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
